Anterior and posterior views retain both lower contours. At two native coronal CT sections through the largest lower-quarter discrepancies, the sloping rims track the air-to-soft-tissue boundaries. The display rounds the label edges, by up to 2.94 mm left and 2.91 mm right in the sampled vertex-to-label-vertex check. Teach the lower contour at this scale.

The anterior selection locates the heart between five lobes and the liver below them. The posterior angle separates both lower lobe boundaries. Two registered native-frame CT slices identify the origin of the rounded basal rims.

The complete editable native payload drops from 17,571,351 to 13,596,421 bytes (22.6%). The earlier frozen mesh trial lost required controls. All 286,402 evaluated default triangles and the alternate native states survive in this edition. Both matched selections are pixel-identical.

The capsule and tissue regions remain identifiable. Two source-mesh sections resolve the region silhouettes across depth, but show fine irregular medullary loops where there is no linked specimen annotation. The capsule supplies the outer outline. Hiding it from the same camera exposes follicles, paracortex and medulla. The two labeled cross-sections repeat these four selections at different levels and show how regional extent changes.

assessments.task: Distinguish the central nasal airspace from the lateral maxillary recesses in the NIH3D cast.

axes.observation: Ordered triangle corners decode to the original positions and normals byte for byte. All 198,408 triangles, original transforms, four known source intersection pairs and the single selectable cast survive across two same-material draw ranges.

The two planar cuts resolve broad lateral spaces around the thin central channels while retaining their exact boundaries. Crowded central relief and the uneven inferior cutoff remain conspicuous externally. The creator identifies a posterior right-maxillary indentation but the released surface has no registered CT, local annotation or patient-side transform to distinguish all nearby relief.

Front and oblique views separate the thin central cast from the broad lateral recesses. Two sections through the same display frame confirm their relative widths and depth. Dimensions and patient-side assignment are outside the source evidence.

Two ordered 16-bit index ranges reduce GLB bytes by 1,154,188 (24.3%) at identical shape, material and node scope. Splitting the draw repeats 1,474 vertex records. All triangle corners are exact, the three silhouettes match, and at most six pixels per 640-pixel camera differ by 1/255.
